title: Latestfile v0.1
description: Schema for the canonical JSON form of a Latestfile: a portable declaration of how a developer, team, or organization uses AI in their development workflow.

toolMap.description: Map from tool name (block label) to tool block. Tool names MUST match the identifier pattern [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*.

toolBlock.description: A tool block. The reserved fields 'from', 'version', and 'provider' are typed; all other fields are vendor-defined and unconstrained.

registryUri.description: A registry URI: registry:[<host>/]<namespace>[/<name>][@<version>]. Hostnames are optional and default to latest.dev. Namespace and name match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*. Version, when present, is a semver-compatible version string.

semverConstraint.description: A semver constraint string. Accepts common forms like '1.0', '1.0.0', '>=1.0', '~> 0.45', '^1.2.3', 'v1.2.3-beta'.
